name_reason: Already conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=battle (core battle-system table cluster in .object2), descriptor=view_window_max_y reflects both purpose (battle view-window maximum y extent) and that it is a scalar coordinate extent. No Ghidra address residue (no _51a8b suffix; the _y / _max_y tokens are semantic). 1:1 sibling of data_fd2_battle_view_window_max_x @ 0x51A87, which keeps the same naming form.
purpose: Battle view-window maximum y extent, in 24x24 map-tile units (value 8): the downward span of the on-screen battle camera relative to the window origin.
logic_summary: Single dword scalar (NOT a table), read via absolute-address load (MOV reg,[0x51A8B]), never base+idx*stride. 1:1 sibling of the x-extent @ 0x51A87, paired across all 15 readers. Two distinct uses: (1) Visible-tile/sprite cull -- a world (x,y) is drawn only when origin_y <= y < origin_y + view_window_max_y (signed JL/JLE), e.g. fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_with_mode @ 0x1DA87 culls when pos_y > origin_y + max_y + 1; (2) Tactical-overview camera in fd2_open_tactical_overview_zoom @ 0x200A1: src_cy_fp_base = origin_y*0xC00 + view_window_max_y*0x600 (16:6 fixed point; the SHL2/SUB/SHL9 sequence computes x*3<<9 = x*0x600), consumed as a full 32-bit integer.
element_semantics: Single 32-bit value = 8. Acts as a non-negative coordinate extent in the visible cull (always small positive, signed compares) and as a plain 32-bit operand in the tactical-overview fixed-point camera arithmetic.
comment_original_issue: The home-file block was accurate and precise, but the line directly above the declaration read '/* Non-const for the same reason as the X sibling above. */' while the declaration is 'const uint32' and globals.h declares 'extern const uint32'. That annotation contradicted the actual (correct) const declaration AND its premise was false (the X sibling above carries no such 'Non-const' line). The symbol has zero game-side writers (all 15 xrefs are READ), so it is genuinely read-only and const is correct.
notes: Removed the contradictory '/* Non-const for the same reason as the X sibling above. */' comment line above the declaration (const is correct: 0 game-side writers; globals.h extern is also const). const keyword/type/value/declaration otherwise unchanged; no logic, type, statement, or control flow touched. Created a concise Ghidra data PLATE_COMMENT (previously null/empty at 0x51A8B) summarizing the scalar's role, the two use sites, sibling/adjacency, and read-only status; content consistent with the src block. Mirrors the treatment of the X sibling @ 0x51A87 (shard 00051a87.json: comment_verdict=rewrite, plate created).
